proof_summary: Trial-division factorization and decimal concatenation are exhaustively evaluated for every smaller integer in finite blocks; the bounds \(2^{15}>28749\) and \(\sqrt n<171\) ensure that at most 15 factors and trial divisors below 171 suffice. At the endpoint, \(28749=3\cdot7\cdot37^2\), and the concatenation is \(373737=13\cdot28749\).
